# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# private pythia+madgraph promotion
Following the previous task the recent 100k production with the NNLO pdf set (NNPDF31) should be promoted to our current working point. Update the official weight dictionary OFFICIAL_EE_WEIGHT_FILE_PP_PRIVATE, OFFICIAL_PRIVATE_PP_5020_INPUT, OFFICIAL_PRIVATE_PP_8160_INPUT variables with the skims and weight factor calculated using the 100k events of
 - 5.02 TeV (NNPDF31_nnlo LHAID=303600)
 - 8.16 TeV (NNPDF31_nnlo LHAID=303600)

Propagate the new MC-driven EE weights to the overleaf by doing the following steps.
 - update the plots in the Systematics:Energy Extrapolation section with new systematics calculated with the new official weight from the dictionary. At this step confirm there is reasonable agreement between the nominal and MC-driven curves (witin 10 percent or so) before propagating to results.
 - calculate the total systematics, update the systematics summary plots and appendix systematics plots.
 - remake all result plots in the results section to use the newly calculated systematic uncertainties
 - copy the new plots to the overleaf
 - also update copilot-instructions with new norms concerning the private mc generation.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
